fields.narrative_intro: *A bleary-eyed person and an awestruck person discuss Jensen Huang’s reinstatement at NVIDIA in a parking garage during an alien invasion.*
fields.panel1:
[setup]
BLEARY-EYED PERSON: "NVIDIA temporarily replaced Jensen Huang with CFO Colette Kress."
AWESTRUCK PERSON: "During an alien invasion, that’s oddly reassuring."
fields.panel2:
[build]
BLEARY-EYED PERSON: "Then officials reviewed his return for national-security risk."
AWESTRUCK PERSON: "Apparently, CEO reinstatement now needs a security clearance."
fields.panel3:
[pivot]
BLEARY-EYED PERSON: "They cleared him—and created a National Security and Export Control Committee."
AWESTRUCK PERSON: "That’s a lot of paperwork for one leather jacket."
fields.panel4:
[silent reaction]
[Visual: Both people stare as a green NATIONAL SECURITY APPROVED stamp descends onto Jensen’s leather jacket.]
fields.panel5:
[punch]
AWESTRUCK PERSON: "First order: announce he’s “the right person” to lead NVIDIA."
BLEARY-EYED PERSON: "Second order: hire a Chief Compliance Officer."
fields.panel6:
[button]
[Visual: Aliens abandon invasion plans, queuing for a glowing Chief Compliance Officer job kiosk marked INTERSTELLAR EXPERIENCE PREFERRED.]

narrative_summary: Jensen Huang’s government-cleared comeback escalates from a CEO swap into export-control bureaucracy while invading aliens apply for compliance jobs.
rationale: Candidate 3 best converts the story’s specific security-clearance and compliance details into a clean escalation, with the leather-jacket line and alien job kiosk providing distinct comic beats. Candidate 2 has the strongest single exchange but is less developed, while Candidates 1 and 4 largely restate the premise visually.
story_title: Jensen Huang Reinstated as Nvidia CEO
place: in a parking garage during an alien invasion
